summary_ja: 実施計画に記載があれば、重要でない事業単位又は資産区分に標準的手法を適用できるが、割合が一定(アセット・クラス全体の十パーセント、一の区分の二パーセント)を超える場合は適用できないことを定める。
summary_en: Allows the standardized approach for immaterial business units or asset categories if the plan so provides, except where they exceed 10% of the asset class or a single unit exceeds 2%.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the preceding two Articles, where so stated in the internal ratings-based approach implementation plan or the advanced internal ratings-based approach transition plan, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may apply the standardized approach to business units or asset categories that are not material in calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets; provided, however, that this does not apply in the cases listed in the following items. (i) Where the ratio of the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated using the standardized approach within an asset class to which the internal ratings-based approach is applied to the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the asset class to which the internal ratings-based approach is applied (including the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated using the standardized approach within that asset class; the same applies in the following item) exceeds 10%. (ii) Where the ratio of the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets relating to a single business unit or asset category using the standardized approach within an asset class to which the internal ratings-based approach is applied to the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the asset class to which the internal ratings-based approach is applied exceeds 2%.
